newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jayhawk cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jayhawk cut to buy.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it lowered its recommendation on Jayhawk Acceptance Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- The analyst said he cut the recommendation after the company's price/earnings to growth rate rose to 46 percent from 33 percent, the level it was at July 12, when the strong buy rating was issued.
-- The analyst said his 12-month price target for the stock is $16.50 per share and that he estimates Jayhawk will earn $0.50 per share in 1996 and $0.75 per share in 1997.
-- Shares slipped 1/8 to 13-1/2 in early Nasdaq trade.
